captions.detailed: A light gray benchtop monocular laboratory microscope. It features a horseshoe-shaped base supporting a curved upright arm, an inclined monocular eyepiece tube, and a square mechanical stage mounted below the objective lens turret. The objective nosepiece rotates about the vertical optical axis, while the stage carrier and full stage assembly slide prismatically to adjust specimen positioning.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a laboratory microscope with a horseshoe base, a curved supporting arm, an inclined monocular eyepiece tube, and a square stage. Ensure the rotating objective turret has a revolute joint, and the stage carrier allows prismatic sliding adjustments.
captions.factory: Construct the microscope by defining a base link using a horseshoe-shaped extruded plate. Build a curved vertical arm and attach an inclined cylinder for the monocular eyepiece tube. Model the objective turret as a cylinder with small objective lens cylinders, and define a revolute joint for its rotation. Create the square stage as a thin rectangular prism, and mount it to the arm using prismatic joints to represent the cross-slide and fore-aft adjustments.
